name: Noam Chomsky
shortBio: Linguist, cognitive scientist, and philosopher; sparked the Cognitive Revolution with his critique of Skinnerian behaviorism and his theory of universal innate grammar.
centralQuestion: What innate biological structures of the human mind make the rapid and creative acquisition of language possible from impoverished sensory input?

keyWorks.title: Syntactic Structures
keyWorks.description: Revolutionized theoretical linguistics with transformational generative grammar.

keyWorks.title: Review of B. F. Skinner's Verbal Behavior
keyWorks.description: Decisive critique initiating the Cognitive Revolution.

keyWorks.title: Language and Mind
keyWorks.description: Connects linguistic competence to philosophical rationalism and innate mental architecture.
